mapper.sql: select s.shipment_id, s.shipment_no, s.work_order_id, w.work_order_no, st.style_name, s.school_name, s.campus_name, s.grade_name, s.class_name, s.total_quantity, s.packed_quantity, s.shipment_status, s.logistics_company, s.logistics_no, s.dispatch_time, s.sign_time, s.create_by, s.create_time, s.update_by, s.update_time, s.remark from xf_shipment_order s left join xf_work_order w on s.work_order_id = w.work_order_id left join xf_uniform_style st on w.style_id = st.style_id
mapper.select:
and s.shipment_no like concat('%', #{shipmentNo}, '%')
and w.work_order_no like concat('%', #{workOrderNo}, '%')
and s.school_name like concat('%', #{schoolName}, '%')
and s.class_name like concat('%', #{className}, '%')
and s.shipment_status = #{shipmentStatus}
and date_format(s.create_time,'%Y%m%d') >= date_format(#{params.beginTime},'%Y%m%d')
and date_format(s.create_time,'%Y%m%d') <= date_format(#{params.endTime},'%Y%m%d')
order by s.create_time desc, s.shipment_id desc
mapper.insert: insert into xf_shipment_order( shipment_no, work_order_id, school_name, campus_name, grade_name, class_name, total_quantity, packed_quantity, shipment_status, logistics_company, logistics_no, dispatch_time, sign_time, remark, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{shipmentNo}, #{workOrderId}, #{schoolName}, #{campusName}, #{gradeName}, #{className}, #{totalQuantity}, #{packedQuantity}, #{shipmentStatus}, #{logisticsCompany}, #{logisticsNo}, #{dispatchTime}, #{signTime}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.update: update xf_shipment_order set total_quantity = #{totalQuantity}, packed_quantity = #{packedQuantity}, shipment_status = #{shipmentStatus}, update_time = sysdate() where shipment_id = #{shipmentId}
